reasons: The cited Section 20.1 is a one-way Customer indemnity for 'every claim' relating to Customer's use of the Services, with no Vendor IP or misconduct indemnity anywhere — squarely walk-away territory under the rule, so the 'missing' classification is correct and actionable.

The redline reaches the preferred position: Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; standard notice/control/cooperation procedure; customary exclusions (modification, combination, Customer specifications); and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies. Customer's indemnity is properly narrowed to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

Directionally correct for the customer and does not concede anything; the high changed-character ratio on p0080 is justified because the rule requires inserting an entire Vendor indemnity and narrowing the existing one-way clause.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, uses the [Playbook] prefix, and correctly notes the dangling Section 9.3 cross-reference to a non-existent Section 20.5, which the inserted numbering resolves.

Minor observations only, not disqualifying: the insertion adds 'Vendor Technology' and 'Affiliates' terms whose definitions are not shown in the supplied excerpt, and no super-cap discussion is needed since the preferred position is achieved.
